# Husk

> HTML-first UI system in development. Plain CSS/JavaScript, light DOM throughout, native controls and optional h- composition. Current major browsers with progressive enhancement.

## Start here

- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): repository rules and actual entry points.
- [Current API](docs/reference.md): implemented layouts, form and summary behavior, tokens.
- [Machine-readable catalogue](docs/components.json): native/foundation/planned statuses; proposed names are not available APIs.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): native ownership, lifecycle, light DOM and future packaging.
- [Form integration](docs/forms.md): external ownership, shared questions, translated feedback and application-owned async submission.
- [Theming](docs/theming.md): implemented reference scales, semantic states/focus, local aliases and supported density scopes.
- [Density](docs/density.md): comfortable/compact composition, nested boundaries, exact consumers and precedence; independent of control size.
- [Controls](docs/controls.md): native button variants, control sizes, supported targets and token names.
- [Conventions](docs/conventions.md): UI/keyboard/focus/form rules.
- [Roadmap](ROADMAP.md): complete component scope and release gate.
- [Accessibility evidence](ACCESSIBILITY.md): actual test results and outstanding manual work.
- [Component specification template](docs/component-template.md): define a widget before coding.

## Working examples

- [Example hub](examples/index.html)
- [Native and composed recipes](examples/patterns.html)
- [Theme workbench](examples/themes.html)
- [Component explorer](examples/components.html)
- [Fieldwork workspace](workspace.html)

Only h-form and h-error-summary are registered behavior elements today. CSS-only wrappers need no registration. There is no published package/import path. Do not invent h-button/h-input replacements for native controls or implement roadmap syntax as if it already exists. Use AGENTS.md for validation commands.
